title: AUDITOR (PERFORMANCE)
company: Council of the Inspectors General on Integrity and Efficiency

title: Assistant engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Responsible for Metal forming \& welding processes like AMF Welding, Sheetmetal forming \& Bending. A key element of this position will be building independently of manifolds and Forming operating machine \& execution of shift out as per plan working closely with each HPT cell followed by ensuring highly committed safety, output, quality, and productivity.
   

  

 Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!
   

  

**Job Description**
**Site Overview:**
 Our Multi\-modal Manufacturing Facility (MMF) in Pune plays a crucial role in manufacturing key aerospace components, supporting not only India’s defense and commercial sectors but also global aviation supply chains. Our relationships with Indian suppliers, combined with our world\-class local facilities and global reach, continue to shape India’s aerospace ecosystem.
   

  

**Role Overview**
* Welding of tubes, air manifolds and sheet metal parts.
* Welding of stainless steel, Inconel material.
* Repair of defective stainless steel and Inconel castings.
* Welding and fabrication by using TIG and Orbital welding processes.
* Ability to read, understand, analyse and interpret drawings, manuals, SOP, MOS and other material to determine finish product.
* Assembly of welded products.
* Shall have multiskilling of welding and fabrication of all parts in the cell
* Shall have familiar with problem solving tools 5Why, Fishbone and know how’s of RCA
* Shall have ability to train other welders
* Hands on experience on Assy manifolds, Marking and fixture check operations.


**The Ideal Candidate**
* Candidate with min 4 years of experience in welding and fabrication


**Required Qualifications**
* Diploma with minimum 4 years of experience in welding and fabrication.
* Shall be certified in welding process as per AWS D17\.1 in 6G position with II A \& III B materials.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Shall have experience to produce X ray quality Class B weld joints, with SS 321 \& Inconel 625 material.


**Closing**
 Whether we are manufacturing components for our engines, driving innovation in fuel and noise reduction, or unlocking new opportunities to grow and deliver more productivity, our GE Aerospace teams are dedicated and making a global impact. Join us and help move the aerospace industry forward
 **.**
